args.message: For each month in 2025, I took the average order value (total order amount ÷ number of orders) and added it to a running total starting in January 2025. By December 2025 the running total is about 801.19. All orders are counted, whatever their status: the data marks some orders "bad", and the question didn't say to leave them out.
